scenes.text: Halloween lands on a Saturday in 2026, and these Miami parties stay under thirty dollars.
Start in Wynwood. HalloWyn returns for its 13th consecutive year at Wynwood Marketplace, from 7 p.m. to 3 a.m. Admission is free, with live DJ sets, drink specials, and a free drink RSVP option.
scenes.caption: Start in Wynwood. HalloWyn returns for its 13th year at Wynwood Marketplace, from 7 p.m. to 3 a.m. Admission is free, with live DJ sets, drink specials, and a free drink RSVP option.

scenes.text: Lincoln Road starts earlier. Kids trick-or-treat from 5:30 to 7:30, then the adult block party takes over around 8. The whole thing runs on the pedestrian mall, and admission is free.
scenes.caption: Lincoln Road starts earlier. Kids trick-or-treat from 5:30 to 7:30, then the adult block party takes over around 8. The whole thing runs on the pedestrian mall, and admission is free.

scenes.text: On Española Way, Kill Your Idol has Night of 1000 Villains at 8 p.m. Admission is free. The costume contest pays $200 cash, and drinks are half off before 10. If you go, open NEAR and see who else hit Villains night.

scenes.text: Churchill’s in Little Haiti is the ticketed pick. Necrodanse starts at 9 p.m. with Last Grasp, In a Darkened Room, and Blood Orchid. DJ Lady Reaper and DJ Jason play between sets. Tickets run $11 to $20.
